scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && node scripts/migrate-postgres.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
